exact_claim: For every prime p>3 and integer n>=3, over k=an algebraic closure of F_p, an explicit p-killed finite flat commutative W(k)-group of rank p^(2n) has quasi-supersingular special fiber; both fiber and Witt lift fail Cartier self-duality.
question_location: Takao, OWR42/2023, printed2479, higher-rank question after Proposition2
assumptions: k is an algebraic closure of F_p
quasi-supersingular filtration requires actual elliptic p-torsion factors over k
finite flat commutative W(k)-group killed by p
boundary_cases: Takao Proposition2 gives positive self-duality for n<=2 under p>3; rank p^6 is the first negative rank in this setting.
No descent to every perfect field asserted.
Characteristic-two and characteristic-three finite-field regressions, if present in supporting controls, are generic semilinear algebra tests, not extensions of the theorem.
No principal polarization, Jacobian realization or Coleman conjecture result asserted.
verified_mechanisms: Six-dimensional semilinear Dieudonne module and exact three-elliptic-factor filtration
Intrinsic dim(im F^2 intersect im V^2) gives 0 on module and 1 on its Cartier dual
Explicit finite Honda complement realizes a W(k)-lift; self-duality would specialize
Direct sums with standard elliptic factors preserve the obstruction for every n>=3
